scope: All35 actual returns inspected across nine source/white/cyan/alpha pages, three exact-native sheets, five candidate boards and ten targeted full raw views.27 actual passes,8 art failures. Original1 Calouste Gulbenkian service refusal remains separate; every review maps to original index plus one. Fine hair repairs retain definite source detail rather than asserting clean-shaven identity. Lavarack brim/eye shadow does not independently establish sunglasses; no new glasses are forced. Elisabeth eye/brow contours likewise do not prove separate frames. Richard Williams actual small gold throat plate is preserved, not rejected merely for its metallic texture. Eugen Beyer larger candidate has different head direction, gaze and cap ornament; it is not used to override this small original collar, and no speculative embroidery repair is ordered. Franz Koritschoner actual shirt/neckwear and Julius Raab unresolved tiny eye contours do not justify invented changes. Partial source shadows and natural mascot albedo alone are not grounds to reject Jacob Vouza. Canonical SHA/attempt-bound decisions determine actual qualification.
